scope: static edition (primary) + server/pg + supabase-mode libs (dormant editions)

findings.title: PostgREST or() filter injection in supabase mode
findings.detail: listTerms interpolated user-controlled q/category into .or() filter syntax; , ( ) metacharacters could alter the filter (data exposure limited: table is public-read by design, but crafted input could error or widen queries).
findings.fix: category validated against fixed allowlist; q stripped of PostgREST metacharacters and wildcards, capped at 80 chars (lib/data.js).

findings.title: Feed-derived URLs rendered into href without scheme check
findings.detail: RSS link fields flowed into <a href> in the static site; a compromised/malicious feed could deliver javascript: URIs. esc() prevents markup injection but not scheme abuse.
findings.fix: safeLink() whitelist (http/https) at data.json generation + safeHref() render gate on all 4 external-link sites; verified by live poisoned-data.json probe.

findings.title: Rate limiter trusted leftmost x-forwarded-for
findings.detail: Leftmost XFF entry is client-spoofable, allowing rate-limit evasion on server edition.
findings.fix: clientKey now prefers cf-connecting-ip / x-real-ip, else rightmost XFF entry (lib/ratelimit.js).

findings.title: No security headers on static hosting
findings.fix: site/_headers added (CSP default-src 'none' + inline allowances the SPA needs, nosniff, DENY framing, referrer & permissions policies). Note: CSP requires 'unsafe-inline' script because the SPA is single-file — accepted; XSS surface separately verified by probe.

findings.title: GH Action push race
findings.detail: Daily commit could fail if another commit landed mid-run.
findings.fix: git pull --rebase before push in workflow.

findings.title: README shows DATABASE_URL template with placeholder password
findings.detail: Placeholder only (<password>) — not a real credential.
findings.fix: none needed; documented format is intentional.

verifications: secret scan: no secret-shaped strings in source/configs/records/site
SQL: all pg queries parameterized; no template interpolation
XSS probe (live browser): 8/8 passed, 0 alerts — hostile search, hostile localStorage note, poisoned data.json headline/link/sourceUrl, javascript: href block
data.json contract: 844 terms, unique ids+names, all links http(s)
ID determinism: two rebuilds produce identical id->term mapping (localStorage saves stable)
regex hostile input: termInText/cleanTerm handle pathological input in 0ms (try/catch fallback)
functional regression after patches: 17/17 static audit, 10/10 unit tests, Next build clean
fixture_origin: All demo/test strings synthetic; no real PII anywhere.
residual_risks: CSP uses 'unsafe-inline' (single-file SPA architecture) — compensated by esc()/safeHref discipline + live probe evidence
GitHub Action supply chain: actions pinned to major tags (v4), not SHAs — acceptable for this project tier
Server edition remains no-auth for writes (documented; dormant — static edition is primary)
